story_text:
## Find Your Perfect Match
## Key Specs at Glance
A NAS is a long-term home for your data. But your needs won’t stand still. Photo libraries grow. Creative projects get larger. New apps demand more performance.
Meet Beelink ME Pro — a modular AI NAS built for changing needs. Its drawer-style compute module brings greater flexibility to upgrades and maintenance, while intelligent data management, professional media tools, and local AI on select models help you do more with your data. Built for your data today. Designed to evolve with you.
## What Makes ME Pro Unique
## Upgrade, Expand, and Maintain Without Replacing the Entire NAS
With conventional fixed-hardware NAS systems, growing demands can mean replacing the entire device. ME Pro’s innovative drawer-style modular design lets you upgrade performance without replacing the entire system.
## Engineered For Quiet, Reliable 24/7 Operation
Your NAS keeps working long after you step away. From overnight backups to demanding workloads, ME Pro combines advanced cooling and vibration control to keep heat and noise in check—day after day, night after night.
An integrated internal blower enables efficient cool-air intake and hot-air exhaust, while an aluminum support frame and thermal pads enhance heat dissipation.
Curious How ME Pro Performs in Real-World Conditions? Watch our tests covering noise levels, operating temperatures, and power consumption.👇
Enjoy quieter performance on your desk or next to your TV, with precision-fit mounting and dual-sided anti-vibration silicone pads helping reduce noise and protect your drives.
## Compact Design. Massive Storage.
ME Pro’s unibody design brings your storage into a sleek, all-metal chassis—50% smaller than a typical NAS with the same number of drive bays. Built to fit your space, not take it over.
No more choosing what to delete. Keep your memories, movies, and projects together—with up to 136TB of raw storage capacity.*
Start with a pre-installed, user-friendly NAS operating system. Organize photos, enjoy your media, and access your files through a clear interface built around everyday use.
## Turn Your NAS Into a Collaborative Media Workspace
ME Pro turns your NAS into a professional media hub where you can preview, search, review, and share large media libraries without leaving your own storage.
## Run AI Models and Agents Locally on NAS
Powered by the AMD Ryzen™ AI 9 HX 470, ME Pro lets you run AI models and agents locally, bringing AI capabilities closer to the files you store. Process data on your NAS without relying on cloud-based inference.
## Your Data. Protected on Multiple Levels.
- End-to-End Encryption
Data is encrypted in transit when using the system's automatic remote relay service, helping protect your private files from interception and unauthorized access.
- Built-In Firewall
Restrict unauthorized network access to help protect your system and data.
- Local Security Certificates
Enable secure, encrypted connections when accessing your files remotely.
## Your NAS. More Possibilities.
## Ports & Connectivity
Connect your NAS to the devices and network behind your everyday workflows. Choose the ME Pro configuration with the connectivity your setup needs.
## Tech Specs
## Choose Your ME Pro
## See ME Pro In Action & Testing
## Unboxing & Quick Start
See how to unbox and set up ME Pro, from installing your drives to connecting and configuring your NAS. Get a quick look at its essential functions and see how to get started.
## ME Pro Software Features & Demo
Explore Fygo OS, ME Pro's intuitive operating system, and discover its built-in apps, AI-powered tools, media management, and remote access features. See how the software brings your NAS experience together.
## A Closer Look at Beelink ME Pro
## What's in the Box?
## Shipping, Taxes & VAT
## After-Sales Services & Customer Support
## About Beelink
ME Pro rethinks NAS design with modular architecture that makes upgrading and maintenance easier. Its compact, all-metal enclosure saves valuable desk space, while an optimized airflow system and vibration-dampening design help keep the system cool and quiet. Every detail is designed to bring powerful storage into your everyday space, without compromising on performance, flexibility, or comfort.
During the early design stage, we explored different layouts, structures, and component arrangements to balance modularity, compact size, cooling, and everyday usability. These early design drafts helped shape the form and architecture of the ME Pro you see today.

faq.q: 1. Payment | When will I be charged for my pledge?
faq.a: Kickstarter will charge your payment method only after the campaign ends and only if the campaign reaches its funding goal.

faq.q: 2. Payment | Can I change my pledge after backing the project?
faq.a:
Yes. While the campaign is live, you can update your reward or pledge amount by clicking “Manage your pledge” and selecting “Change your pledge” on the campaign page. Please note that pledges cannot be changed after the campaign ends.
See Kickstarter’s guide �
https://help.kickstarter.com/en-us/articles/16236517-how-can-i-change-my-pledge-amount-or-reward-selection

faq.q: 3. Payment | Can I order two ME Pro NAS units, either the same model or different models?
faq.a:
Yes! You can order two ME Pro units, whether they are the same model or different models, by following these steps:
1. Select your preferred model as your main Reward and complete your pledge.
2. Go to the "Add-ons" section and select the second ME Pro model you want to order.
3. Complete your pledge, and both ME Pro units will be included in your order.

faq.q: 4. Payment | How do I confirm my pledge?
faq.a: Log in to Kickstarter and check “Backed Projects” to find your pledge and its status.

faq.q: 5. Payment | Why was my credit card declined?
faq.a: Check your card details and available funds, or contact your bank if the transaction was blocked. You can also try another supported payment method.

faq.q: 6. Payment | Can I pledge after the campaign ends?
faq.a: We plan to sell ME Pro on the official Beelink website after the campaign at a higher price than the Early Bird offers. Back during the campaign to enjoy exclusive pricing and benefits.

faq.q: 7. Payment | Are the prices displayed in USD?
faq.a: Yes. All prices on this campaign page are listed in US dollars (USD). If your payment method uses another currency, your bank or card issuer may apply its own exchange rate and conversion fees.

faq.q: 8. Limited Time Gift | How can I get the free screwdriver kit within 48 hours?
faq.a: Place your pledge on Kickstarter before November 7, 2026, at 10:00 AM EST to qualify for a free screwdriver kit. The gift will be included with your reward after the campaign ends.

faq.q: 9. Product | Are HDDs included？What is the maximum storage capacity?
faq.a: HDDs are sold separately. Selected 4-Bay models support up to 136TB with compatible HDDs installed. See the Tech Specs section for model-specific capacity details.

faq.q: 10. Module Motherboard | Will my data and settings be preserved when I replace the core module?
faq.a: Yes. Your existing data, RAID configuration, and Fygo OS settings can be retained when replacing a compatible core module, as the storage drives remain unchanged.

faq.q: 11. Module Motherboard | Will ME Pro NAS modules and chassis be sold separately?
faq.a:
This campaign offers complete ME Pro NAS systems only. 
We plan to sell motherboard modules and 2-Bay or 4-Bay chassis separately on the official Beelink website after the campaign. 
More details on how to purchase them will be shared in the future.

faq.q: 12. Software | What operating system does ME Pro use? Can I install other operating systems?
faq.a:
ME Pro comes with Fygo OS preinstalled.
Compatible third-party systems, such as TrueNAS or Unraid, can also be installed, depending on hardware and software compatibility.

faq.q: 13. Software | Does ME Pro support Docker and virtual machines?
faq.a: Yes. Fygo OS supports Docker and virtual machines. Performance depends on the selected hardware model and software configuration.

faq.q: 14. Software | Can I use Jellyfin or Plex on ME Pro?
faq.a: Yes. ME Pro supports both Jellyfin and Plex for media streaming. Plex hardware transcoding requires a Plex Pass subscription; without it, software transcoding may struggle with 4K or multiple simultaneous streams.

faq.q: 15. Software | Does ME Pro support RAID and JBOD?
faq.a: JBOD is supported. ME Pro does not use hardware RAID; RAID is managed by system software such as Fygo OS. Available RAID levels depend on the bay count and file system; Check the current system support list for details.
